name: Cantillana (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and green in the proportions 3:1:3, charged at the centre with the arms of Cantillana beneath a mural crown (a castle on red within an inscribed bordure).
history: The arms and flag of Cantillana were entered officially in the Registro Andaluz de Entidades Locales on 22 October 2014, published in the BOJA on 4 November 2014; the flag is a rectangular cloth of proportion 11 by 18 with three stripes, the upper and lower of 3/7 of the height each, the first red.

features.role: Cantillana arms — castle on red within an inscribed bordure, beneath a mural crown
